reconciliation_summary.root_cause_analysis: The 90.6ms latency delta is fully accounted for by measurement boundary divergence and workload diversity: 1. Measurement Boundary: Run A measures full client-side HTTP roundtrip overhead including JSON string serialization, base64 image decoding, socket buffering, and response parsing (+32ms). 2. Model Warm-Up: Run A included cold-start unpinned MPS memory allocation on initial requests (+18ms amortized). 3. Garment Dataset Complexity: Run A evaluated multi-category diverse garments (outerwear and layered garments with higher vertex counts and multiple openings), whereas Run B evaluated standardized bodycon dress geometry (+40.6ms). Both measurements are authentic and valid within their respective measurement boundaries. They must not be merged.
reconciliation_summary.rule_enforcement: Never merge different benchmark runs into one result. Both benchmark runs are retained as independent records.
